of\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECheif complaints :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1-Tingling and Numbness of both lower limbs since 5 years .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2- ulcer over left foot since 4 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3-one episode of Involuntary movements of upper and lower limb 10 days back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of presenting illness :\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis history dates back to 15 years when he visited hospital for the fever and on investigations he was found to be diabetic .He used oral hypoglycemia agents initially for 5 years and was on followup.He was complaint to medications and had no health issues.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELater he developed tingling and Numbness of both foot since 5 years ,which he ignored initially as the symptoms were intermittent and not disabling .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen he noticed\u0026nbsp; redness and swelling of left lower limb ,that progressed to blisters and ulcer over dorsal aspect of left foot.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter few days there was discoloration of left 2nd toe for which he was hospitalized and his left 2 nd toe was amputated .But the ulcer progressed to forefoot,so regular dressings were done and skin grafting was done .During this hospitalisation he was advised to use insulin for daibetes.He was prescribed Insulin Human Mixtard 18 u in the morning and 12 units in the night before food.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis ulcer resolved over 3 months .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 4 years patient complaints of loss of sensation over both foot \u0026nbsp;till ankle .It was gradual in onset and progressed \u0026nbsp;to current state. He was unable to perceive hot or sensation in both lower limbs till ankle region .He couldn't perceive the pain sensation following an injury .He also complaints of cotton wool sensations .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere were episodes of frequent slippage of footwear unknowingly .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 year he is complaining of tingling and numbness over fingertips intermittently.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere were washbasin attacks.No history of swaying or gait disturbances.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo difficulty in getting up from sitting or squatting position.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo difficulty in climbing stairs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo difficulty in combing hair , buttoning and unbuttoning shirt ,mixing food.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of falls\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo bowel and bladder disturbances.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo abnormal sweating and no postural instability or syncopal attacks .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInspite \u0026nbsp;of all these symptoms he never consulted a doctor .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen after 4 months back , patient noticed small ulcer on the same foot for which he was grafted previously .Within no time ulcer progressed and he got admitted in our hospital . Daily dressings were done and was advised for grafting .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient went home and on returning back to the hospital on motor bike, patient suffered burn injury to right foot by the silencer .He couldn't perceive the pain , throughout the journey ,he noticed it after he reached the hospital ,which was taken care after admission.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; On 13\/5\/2022 grafting was done ,and he was kept under observation ,his post operative events were uneventful, hence shifted to general ward .On 23\/5\/2022 patient had suddenly developed involuntary movements of both upper and lower limbs for 1 minute associated with loss of awareness, drooling of saliva ,uprolling \u0026nbsp;of eye balls ,and involuntary defecation .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo head injury ,tongue bite.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFollowing this patient was drowsy for the next 2 days ,with intermittent regaining of consciousness.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of similiar complaints in the past.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of fever , headache , vomitings.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo speech dustubances ,no difficulty in swallowing ,no visual dustubances ,no weakness of limbs ,no sensory disturbances .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe is Diabetic since 15 years and on insulin therapy since 10 EXAM PRACTICAL"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"40 year old women who\u0026nbsp; worked as farmer till last year ,she has to stop working because of her health issues .\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was married at the age of 15 years.Mother of 3 children .All pregnancy were uneventful .she had 2 LsCs surgeries.She recieved blood transfusion for the first time during her last child birth.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was apparently assymptomatic 8 gets back and then she presented to our hospital with history of 1 month of fever ,15 days of jaundice and pedal edema.Bleeding per rectum and mass per rectum ,history of Malena since 1 week .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn investigations - she was found to be severely anemic with Hemoglobin - 2.6 ,low platelet count - 50000.She received 3 PRBC transfusions then her hemoglobin improved to 7.4 but her platelet count was 40000 .She left against medical advise,but she used oral hematinics for 6 months .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELater she lost follow up and she never visited hospital again .Her symotoms of bleeding PR ,jaundice fever subsided and never recurred according to patient.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter 3 years - she presented again with history of generalised weakness.On investigations her hemoglobin was still low - It was 3.3 ,TLC count was 4000 ,plt count -54000.She was treated as megaloblastic anemia .She recived 2 PRBC transfusion during this admission and hemoglobin improved to 6.5 and she got discharged .She had not used any IM or oral medicines.Later she continued to have fatigue , generalised weakness but she never came back for followup.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOne year back because of persistent symptoms she got CBP done in private lab and was told to have severe anemia with thrombocytopenia.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient denies history of loose stools ,steatorrhea ,pain abdomen ,Malena ,hematuria,no night sweats ,no fevers ,no chronic cough\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDietary history \u003C\/b\u003E- She consumes mixed diet .She eats thrice daily .Her diet consist of fresh vegetables ,and twice monthly meat.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 month - she is been complaining of loss of appetite and weight loss.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EChief complaints - \u003C\/b\u003EPatient this time presented to us with history of loss of appetite and loss of weight since 1 month.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was amennorheic for 4 months , later she developed menorrhagia with hypermenorrhia - she bled for 10 days continuously - changing\u0026nbsp; 3-4pads per day with large clots .She thought it would resolve but it was continuous and she fell ill and brought to our casualty with giddiness and profound fatigue and weakness.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn examination she was tachypneic ,pallor with bilateral pitting pedal edema ,Raised JVP.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHyperpigmented knuckles ,\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBald tongue with loss of papillae.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n \u003Ca recurrent Bicytopenia with High output cardiac failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPeripheral smear suggest Megaloblastic anemia secondary to either nutritional or bone marrow failure syndomes .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMennorhgia secondary to thrombocytopenia ?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2)Hypoproteinemia - secondary to malnutrition \/ protein losing ?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3) Subclinical Hypothyroidism\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDiscussion-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E1) \u003C\/b\u003EDespite the fact that patient recived multiple transfusions her Hemoglobin improved acutely but she recurred -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIt could be either blood loss or impaired bone marrow production.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2) Though she gives history of hemorrhoids 8 years back ,she never complained of Malena or bleeding per rectum after that episode .Stool for occult came out be negative .So anemia due to chronic blood less is less likely.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3) Decreased production is evident with low retic count and reticulocyte production index.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4) Impaired production can be either due to - Nutritional deficiencies ,bone marrow failure syndromes.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E5) Marcovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils can be seen in either of the conditions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6) Hypoalbuminemia , Hypoproteinemia - is it secondary to losing protien ? Or malnutrition ?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAs her CRP is negative and she doesn't have any acute febrile illness episode , Hypoalbuminenia as negative phase reactant is ruled out .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EApproach to Bicytopenia\/ pancytopenia -With megaloblastic picture:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
